description: Implementation of the LanguageService interface managing language entities, including fetching languages by code, converting between Language objects and Locale, and caching language lists.

classes.name: LanguageServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing language-related business logic, including retrieval and conversion of language data, with caching support.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a Language entity by its code.

methods.name: toLocale
methods.description: Convert a Language object to a Java Locale.

methods.name: toLanguage
methods.description: Convert a Locale to a Language object.

methods.name: getLanguagesMap
methods.description: Get a map of language codes to Language objects.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieve the list of all Language entities, utilizing caching.
